en:
## New Features

- Codex: support personal access tokens and Agent Identity (Ed25519) credentials, with on-demand task registration and automatic 401 recovery; private keys are never logged or exposed
- Codex-compatible skill discovery, including `.codex/skills` and `openai.yaml` sidecar support
- Added a dedicated translation model setting for reasoning blocks

## Improvements

- Rewrote the agent loop with tool execution groups and settlement logic for more reliable multi-tool runs
- Tool calls now normalize numeric arguments leniently, clamping out-of-range or string values at runtime instead of failing validation
- Persistent tool state survives server restarts via the new tool-continuation service
- Overhauled the update system with a new coordinator and recovery service, plus graceful server shutdown tracking
- Reworked clipboard and image handling into a dedicated module
- Enhanced the setup wizard and settings UI

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed syntax highlighting crash on legacy Safari (iOS 16) by switching to the WASM Shiki engine while preserving full coverage
- Various frontend fixes and PWA reload reliability improvements
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- Codex：支持个人访问令牌（PAT）和 Agent Identity（Ed25519）凭证，按需注册任务并自动从 401 恢复；私钥不会被记录或泄露
- 兼容 Codex 的技能发现机制，支持 `.codex/skills` 和 `openai.yaml` sidecar
- 新增推理块专用的翻译模型设置

## 改进

- 重写 agent loop，引入工具执行组和结算逻辑，多工具运行更可靠
- 工具调用现在会宽松地规范化数值参数，运行时对越界或字符串值做钳制，而非直接校验失败
- 通过新的工具续跑服务，工具状态可在服务器重启后持久保留
- 全面改造更新系统，新增更新协调器和恢复服务，并支持服务器优雅关闭跟踪
- 将剪贴板与图片处理重构为独立模块
- 优化初始化向导和设置界面

## 修复

- 修复旧版 Safari（iOS 16）语法高亮崩溃问题，改用 WASM Shiki 引擎并保持完整覆盖
- 多项前端修复及 PWA 重载可靠性改进
